editorial:
Imagine being a free spirit who loves the single life, only to find out your grandfather left you millions of dollars with one crazy catch. You have to be married by 6:05 pm on your 30th birthday, or you get absolutely nothing. That is the mess Jimmie finds himself in. He already messed things up with his girlfriend, Anne, by giving her a terrible proposal. Now, he is in a race against the clock, desperately calling every girl he has ever dated to see who will say yes to a quick wedding. It is a classic high-stress comedy that feels like a wild ride from start to finish.

The movie moves quickly and keeps you laughing as Jimmie gets more and more desperate. While some of the jokes feel a bit dated, the chemistry between the leads is great and the pacing never slows down. If you enjoy movies where everything goes wrong in the funniest way possible, you will love this. You can grab a digital rental on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a collector, adding the Blu-ray to your shelf is a solid move. It is a perfect pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: In the end, Jimmie realizes that money is not as important as true love. He stops chasing the fortune and instead focuses on winning Anne back. After a series of chaotic events, he finally proves he has changed his ways. He and Anne reconcile and get married for the right reasons, not because of a will. They end up together, and Jimmie finds happiness without needing the grandfather's millions to feel successful.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy rom-coms and race-against-the-clock plots.
